title: Jellyfin Transcode Hotspot by Client
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=jellyfin:activity
| stats count(eval(transcode="true")) as transcodes, count as sessions by client
| eval transcode_pct=round(100*transcodes/sessions,1)
| where sessions>=5 AND transcode_pct>50
| sort - transcode_pct
description: Uses Jellyfin playback activity telemetry to monitor how often each client forces a transcode in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for devices creating unnecessary media-server load, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Jellyfin playback activity data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how often each client forces a transcode so you can spot devices creating unnecessary media-server load before it becomes annoying.
